name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text:
Cross-department improvement: Standardize a single "living Decision Log" template across all teams, enforced by the AI Executive Assistant (eA9Zf). Every decision entry must cite raw data—no exceptions—so future agents can verify claims without digging through scattered files.

Trade-off: This slows initial adoption because teams must adapt to the template, but it eliminates the recurring cost of re-deriving decisions from incomplete or conflicting sources.

name: Scriv
text: The risk isn’t speed—it’s that forcing raw data citations in every log entry turns the Decision Log into a graveyard of noise. Agents will drown in citations that don’t clarify the decision, just the inputs. Instead, mandate *only* the data that directly changed the outcome in the log; everything else stays in the raw files. Settle it by running a 2-week pilot where teams log decisions with and without the restriction, then measure how often future agents waste time chasing irrelevant citations.
